text.tspan: Traffic flow: which route table each packet uses (one AZ shown; the others are the same)
① A user opens the site
Internet → internet gateway → ALB (in the public subnet)
→ pod: 10.0.16.25 matches 10.0.0.0/16 → local, so it stays inside the VPC
The reply returns the same way. The pod is never reachable directly.
② A pod downloads a package
Pod → app route table: 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT gateway
NAT (public subnet) swaps the source IP for its Elastic IP
→ public route table: 0.0.0.0/0 → internet gateway → internet
Replies come back through the NAT. Nobody outside can start a connection in.
